reason: It's free for the month and it's actually built for Bengaluru and Kannada creators like me, not another national app that skips regional people, so I'll sign up and try it. The DOSA auto-DM fits my food reels perfectly, but I'd only pay the ₹499 once a local café actually pays me through it.
objection: Influish costs the same and already has lakhs of creators; a small beta team in one city might not have enough real businesses on it to get me paid collabs.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free month there are no real paid offers from South Bengaluru cafés and places in my feed, I won't renew; seeing a list of actual local businesses already on Mitra would make me sure.
